newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to offer A$600 mln in T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to offer A$600 mln in T-bonds.

text.p: The Treasury will offer a total of A$600 million in Treasury bonds through a tender on Tuesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.
The offering will comprise A$200 million of 7.0 percent bonds maturing in April 2000 and A$400 million of 10.0 percent bonds maturing in October 2007.
The bank said bids would be received until 12.45 p.m. (0145 GMT) on Tuesday and results will be announced at 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT). Settlement date is January 16.
